The '''[[Eredivisie|Netherlands Football League Championship]] 1940–1941''' was contested by 52 teams participating in five divisions. The national champion would be determined by a play-off featuring the winners of the eastern, northern, southern and two western football divisions of the [[Netherlands]]. [[Heracles Almelo|Heracles]] won its second championship this year by beating [[PSV Eindhoven]], [[ADO Den Haag]], [[Be Quick 1887]] and [[Telstar (football club)|VSV]].
